question:
The constituent assembly was formed on the recommendation of the Cabinet Mission which visited India in ____________.

[SSC MTS 2022]
options: 1962
1959
1952
1946
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1946

Explanation:
The Constituent Assembly was formed on the recommendation of the Cabinet Mission, which visited India in 1946. The Cabinet Mission consisted of three British ministers - Pethick Lawrence, Stafford Cripps, and A.V. Alexander. Its objective was to propose a plan for the formation of a Constituent Assembly and an interim government before granting independence to India. The first meeting of the Constituent Assembly was held on 9th December 1946, chaired by Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha. Later, Dr. Rajendra Prasad became its permanent President.

Extra Facts:
☛ As per the Cabinet Mission Plan, the Constituent Assembly had 389 members – 292 from British provinces, 93 from princely states, and 4 from Chief Commissioner’s provinces.
☛ The Assembly took 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days to draft the Indian Constitution.
☛ The Constitution was adopted on 26th November 1949 and came into force on 26th January 1950.

solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 1946

Explanation:
संविधान सभा का गठन कैबिनेट मिशन की सिफारिश पर किया गया था, जिसने 1946 में भारत का दौरा किया था। कैबिनेट मिशन तीन ब्रिटिश मंत्रियों - पेथिक लॉरेंस, स्टैफोर्ड क्रिप्स और ए.वी. अलेक्जेंडर से बना था। इस मिशन का उद्देश्य भारत को स्वतंत्रता देने से पहले एक संविधान सभा के गठन और अंतरिम सरकार बनाने के लिए योजना तैयार करना था। संविधान सभा की पहली बैठक 9 दिसंबर 1946 को हुई थी, जिसकी अध्यक्षता डॉ. सच्चिदानंद सिन्हा ने की थी। बाद में डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद संविधान सभा के अध्यक्ष बने।

question:
What was the total time taken to draft the Constitution of India?

[RRB NTPC CBT]
options: 2 years, 10 months and 17 days
2 years, 7 months and 17 days
2 years, 11 months and 18 days
2 years, 9 months and 10 days
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2 years, 11 months and 18 days

Explanation:
The drafting of the Indian Constitution took a total of 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days. The Constituent Assembly held its first meeting on 9 December 1946, and the Constitution was finally adopted on 26 November 1949. During this period, the Assembly held 11 sessions and deliberated for 166 days. The Drafting Committee, chaired by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, prepared the draft, which was finalized after multiple amendments and debates.

Extra Facts:
☛ The President of the Constituent Assembly was Dr. Rajendra Prasad.
☛ The Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950, celebrated as Republic Day.
☛ The Assembly initially had 389 members, but after partition, it was reduced to 299.
☛ The Constitution drew inspiration from various global constitutions, including those of the USA, UK, Ireland, and Canada.

☛ Who was the final President of the Constituent Assembly? → Dr. Rajendra Prasad
☛ When was the Constitution enforced? → 26 January 1950
☛ Who chaired the Drafting Committee? → Dr. B.R. Ambedkar
☛ How many sessions did the Constituent Assembly hold? → 11

options_hi: 2 वर्ष , 10 महीने और 17 दिन

☛ संविधान निर्माण में दुनिया के विभिन्न संविधानों से प्रेरणा ली गई, जैसे अमेरिका, ब्रिटेन, आयरलैंड और कनाडा।

question:
Who was the chairman of the drafting committee of the Constituent Assembly of India?

[SSC MTS 2024]
options: Bhimrao Ambedkar
Vallabhbhai Patel
Rajendra Prasad
JB Kripalani
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bhimrao Ambedkar

Explanation:
The chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly of India was Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar. The committee was formed on 29 August 1947 and consisted of 7 members. Ambedkar is also known as the 'Father of the Indian Constitution' due to his pivotal role in drafting the Constitution. The President of the Constituent Assembly was Dr. Rajendra Prasad, while Vallabhbhai Patel chaired the Provincial Constitution Committee.

Extra Facts:
- Other members of the Drafting Committee included Alladi Krishnaswamy Ayyar, N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar, K.M. Munshi, Syed Mohammad Saadullah, B.L. Mitter (later replaced by N. Madhav Rao).
- The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949, celebrated as Constitution Day.
- The Constitution came into effect on 26 January 1950, observed as Republic Day.

- संविधान लागू हुआ 26 जनवरी, 1950 को, जिस दिन को गणतंत्र दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है।

question:
Who moved the Objective Resolution that was later adapted as the Preamble of the Constitution of India?

[SSC CGL 2022]
options: Rajendra Prasad
JB Kripalani
Jawaharlal Nehru
BR Ambedkar
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Jawaharlal Nehru

Explanation:
Jawaharlal Nehru moved the 'Objective Resolution' in the Constituent Assembly on 13 December 1946, which outlined the fundamental principles and goals of the Indian Constitution. This resolution later became the basis of the Preamble of the Constitution. It included principles like sovereignty, democracy, socialism, secularism, and fundamental rights. The Constituent Assembly adopted this resolution on 22 January 1947.

Extra Facts:
☛ The first meeting of the Constituent Assembly was held on 9 December 1946, presided by Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha.
☛ Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the permanent President of the Constituent Assembly.
☛ The Preamble is called the 'Soul of the Constitution', upheld in landmark cases like Berubari Union Case (1960) and Kesavananda Bharati Case (1973).
☛ The 42nd Constitutional Amendment (1976) added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity' to the Preamble.

This Act was passed by the British Parliament, which established India and Pakistan as two independent Dominions. Under this Act, the Constituent Assembly was given the authority to frame a new constitution for India. The Constituent Assembly was formed on 9 December 1946 and adopted the Constitution on 26 November 1949.

Extra Facts:
- The Indian Independence Act, 1947 was passed by the British Parliament on 18 July 1947 and came into effect on 15 August 1947.
- This Act formally announced the partition of India and Pakistan.
- The President of the Constituent Assembly was Dr. Rajendra Prasad, who later became the first President of India.
- The final session of the Constituent Assembly was held on 24 January 1950 when Dr. Rajendra Prasad was elected as the President of India.

संविधान सभा को भारतीय स्वतंत्रता अधिनियम, 1947 की धारा ______ द्वारा मान्यता दी गई थी।

[SSC CGL 2022]
options_hi: 6(2)
10(1)
12(2)
8(1)
solution_hi:
हल: सही उत्तर है 8(1)

Explanation:
भारतीय स्वतंत्रता अधिनियम, 1947 की धारा 8(1) द्वारा संविधान सभा को मान्यता दी गई थी। यह अधिनियम ब्रिटिश संसद द्वारा पारित किया गया था, जिसने भारत और पाकिस्तान को दो स्वतंत्र डोमिनियन के रूप में स्थापित किया। इस अधिनियम के तहत, संविधान सभा को भारत के लिए एक नया संविधान बनाने का अधिकार दिया गया था। यह संविधान सभा 9 दिसंबर 1946 को गठित की गई थी और 26 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान को अंगीकृत किया गया।

Extra Facts:
- भारतीय स्वतंत्रता अधिनियम, 1947 को 18 जुलाई 1947 को ब्रिटिश संसद द्वारा पारित किया गया और 15 अगस्त 1947 को लागू हुआ।
- इस अधिनियम ने भारत और पाकिस्तान के बीच विभाजन की औपचारिक घोषणा की।
- संविधान सभा के अध्यक्ष डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद थे, जो बाद में भारत के प्रथम राष्ट्रपति बने।
- संविधान सभा की अंतिम बैठक 24 जनवरी 1950 को हुई, जब डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद को भारत का राष्ट्रपति चुना गया।
